name: Flip Clock: Big Digital Alarm
description: A big flip, digital or retro clock for your desk or nightstand, in your colors, with alarms that ring on Silent and in Focus, a 12/24-hour switch, night dimming and widgets. It appears on your Home Screen as Flip Clock.
availability: In development. Coming to the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
